status: proposed; not implemented by this review
acceptance_scope: Public/generated proposal prototype before authentic bank trials

requirements.meaning: Graph family, endpoint marks and background restrictions
local_acceptance: Three-node exhaustive graph enumeration and chain class membership
Invalid family marks and cycles rejected by a declared class recognizer
PAG circle/arrow/tail and all supported mixed edges survive each native conversion
requirements.refusal: unsupported_graph_family or invalid_graph_class; no silently selected DAG
requirements.remaining: Select and inspect a complete recognizer for each supported family; finite enumeration does not prove general completeness.

local_acceptance: Resolve every member and verify exact bytes/schema
Missing/corrupt/duplicated members and mismatched variables
Union-of-edges and first-member substitutions fail the chain and equal-law references
requirements.refusal: unavailable_member, incompatible_member or unsupported_identification; preserve original class
requirements.remaining: Actual member resolution and native library conversion acceptance; syntax counts are insufficient.

local_acceptance: Same-unit reversed order is rejected or explicitly reindexed
Duplicate/missing coordinates refused
Permute estimate,covariance,joint constraints and financial weights together
Use unequal sentinel values; verify proposed retail/corporate net25 versus misread-5USD
requirements.remaining: A successor schema and all adapter implementations; IDs do not certify the truth of an attached value.

requirements.meaning: Topology and set semantics survive mappings
local_acceptance: Unknown,empty,whole-line,singleton and disconnected cases
Negative affine map reverses endpoints and component order
Nonlinear mappings use proved images or labelled outer bounds
Joint line versus rectangular projection net-value reference
Unknown member is never dropped as empty
requirements.remaining: Supported joint-region representation, certified arithmetic for declared domain, and statistical construction review; coordinate boxes alone lose relations.

requirements.meaning: Shared numeric and canonical context encoding
local_acceptance: Exact large identifiers remain strings
2^53+1 singleton rejected or preserved in an explicit exact representation
Integral float12.0 and integer12 follow declared canonical equivalence rule
Actual changed context remains rejected
Unbounded endpoints remain explicit; no NaN or finite sentinel substitution
requirements.remaining: Shared encoding implementation and Python/R/Java/C++/Node byte and numeric fixtures; changing numeric schema requires a versioned successor.

requirements.meaning: Scientific validity remains separate from successful transport
local_acceptance: Supplied-DAG back-door failure retains its limited scope
Unsupported graph classes publish no numeric effect
Pointwise coverage not relabelled simultaneous
All failed/unavailable/native cases remain in denominator
Generated equal observed laws retain different intervention effects
requirements.refusal: unsupported_method or unresolved_identification; do not claim general nonidentification without a certificate
requirements.remaining: Regime-specific causal/uncertainty research; universal latent temporal recovery is not promised.

prototype_sequence: Implement one graph-family recognizer and typed coordinate/codec successor
Execute exact/adverse cases at every actually implemented native boundary
Match library,CLI and MCP outputs plus refusal/error behavior
Run registered generated truth and suitable documented public examples
Use the resulting comparison to justify or reject later costly bank trials

independent_reviewer: Graph/identification and joint-coverage review in the declared regime

known_routes: Stable coordinate binding and explicit reindexing
Generated adversarial acceptance cases for chosen native routes
unresolved_science: Additional information distinguishing observationally equivalent causal models
General latent/temporal graph retention and effect-set calibration
Decision-useful precision for a chosen dependent regime
limits: Proposal requirement review, not full graph recognition or a qualified causal product.
Actual Python validator/service and Node JSON probes use authored fixtures, not bank observations.
No R/Java/C++ adapter, MCP transport, sibling consumer, discovery package or live model execution.
Exact sets and monetary values are stipulated constructions, not fitted uncertainty or bank ROI.
General PAG/temporal class recognition, identification, retention and useful joint uncertainty remain research/engineering obligations.
Public/generated prototype cases precede later authentic owner, clock, graph, platform and economic acceptance.
Rendered visual acceptance and whole-program coverage/depth remain open.
